name: Dungeon Crawler
description: Descend a seeded stack of procedural floors where authored rooms, traps, fog, and a boss at the bottom turn 'one more floor' into a session. The app's dd-* TypeScript generators already prove this loop; this pack declares the library-native contract they map onto.

signatureCompound.name: Floor Descent Loop
signatureCompound.description: floor_descent derives the seed and emits the floor, room_template stamps authored rooms into it, fog_of_war_reveal records what the party has seen, trap_system hides the teeth, and boss_encounter_script closes the bottom floor. Descend, repeat, die wiser.
